description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Generator class within the HTML format implementation of the Daux documentation generator system. It tests various aspects of page generation including single page output, analytics integration, configuration options like search and external links, landing page creation, and raw page handling.

classes.name: GeneratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Generator's page output in various configurations within the HTML format of the Daux documentation generator.

methods.name: getDaux
methods.description: Sets up a virtual file system with sample documentation content, configures and returns a Daux instance.

methods.name: testGenerateSinglePage
methods.description: Tests the generation of a single documentation page with navigation, breadcrumb, search, and navigation highlighting.

methods.name: testGenerateAnalytics
methods.description: Validates that analytics scripts (Google Analytics, Piwik, Plausible) are correctly embedded based on configuration.

methods.name: testGenerateSinglePageWithoutSearch
methods.description: Checks that search elements are omitted when disabled in configuration.

methods.name: testGenerateSidebarLinks
methods.description: Validates rendering of external links and social media widgets in the sidebar.

methods.name: testGenerateLandingPage
methods.description: Verifies generation of the landing page with links, buttons, and repository info.

methods.name: testGenerateRawPage
methods.description: Checks that raw pages like SVG or other non-HTML content are handled correctly.
